synopsis:
In 193 AD, Guo Jia presents a ruthless strategy: "Take one city, and ten will surrender." Cao Cao uses the pretext of avenging his father to invade Xuzhou. Historical records say that hundreds of thousands of men and women were killed.

Taking on Zhao Yun's identity, Liaoyuan Huo helps the people and soldiers of Xuzhou defend their home, matching wits with Cao Cao's forces while secretly drawing Liu Bei into the conflict to join the fight against Cao Cao. Lü Bu, lying low in Chenliu, follows his strategist Chen Gong's plan and launches a surprise attack on Cao Cao's rear. The Crouching Dragon and Sima Yi also arrive in Xuzhou, turning the tides and stirring the battlefield.

The Battle of Xuzhou brings Lü Bu, Xu Chu, Dian Wei, Zhao Yun, and other formidable warriors into a deadly clash that shakes the land. After the battle, Xuzhou changes hands. Cao Cao then turns his sights on his powerful rivals in the north, setting the stage for a contest that will decide the fate of the realm.

(Source: Bilibili)
